name: Cartesia
summary: Real-time voice AI provider with Sonic text-to-speech, Ink speech-to-text and managed voice agents.
description: Cartesia builds real-time voice models for developers. Its products are Sonic for text-to-speech, Ink for speech-to-text and a managed platform for production voice agents, covering 44 languages. The site provides a voice library, free tools and startup programmes. The pricing page did not render during this check, so no price was recorded. The company provides a startup programme, published research and a library of voices and languages for developers to test.
